roles.label: Grantler Dongle
roles.description: interface to MIDI host with display and menu

roles.label: Client
roles.description: board to connect sensors and actuators

roles.label: Print MAC
roles.description: prints the MAC address to serial (use this if you are not using a dongle with display)

roles.label: DMX Client
roles.description: MIDI to DMX512 via an RS-485 transceiver: DMX out on GPIO 21 (to DI); GPIO 4 drives DE/RE, only needed if the module does not enable itself (Grove DMX512 does)

roles.label: Echo Client
roles.description: sends every received MIDI message straight back (for testing connections)

roles.label: NFC Client
roles.description: sends a mapped MIDI message per NFC tag (PN532 over I2C)
